newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil gains over $1 on firmer futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil gains over $1 on firmer futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil was bumped higher on Tuesday by stronger IPE futures and steady premiums, traders said. Activity on the spot physical market remained slow.
May IPE gas oil broke through resistance to make an intra-day high of $168.00 a tonne, before slipping back a touch to $167.25, up $1.50.
Traders said the futures gains had limited the already thin barge buying interest. Premiums were steady at May IPE +75 cents fob AR for refinery material with flat still talked for storage.
Diesel barge and cargo premiums held firm on the back of continued tight supply.
"The offers are fading as the bids draw closer," commented one trader.
EN590 cargoes were pegged at May IPE +$13.50 to $14.50 cif NWE while barges were $3 or so lower for fob.
Heating oil cargo premiums were steady around May IPE +$4.50 for little talked FOD, although DIN appeared to be attracting more demand and premiums a couple of dollars higher than FOD.
